# quadlet Provider

Deploys Quadlets, native systemd user units and their configuration files over SSH or locally on Linux. Quadlets are validated with the host's generator. Podman secrets use the Podman API. Requires Terraform 1.11+ or OpenTofu 1.11+.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    quadlet = {
      source = "savely-krasovsky/quadlet"
    }
  }
}

provider "quadlet" {
  host             = "192.0.2.10"
  user             = "deploy"
  private_key_file = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
  host_key         = "ssh-ed25519 AAAA..."
}

# Alternative: manage the Linux machine running Terraform as its process user.
# Omit host, user and every other SSH argument when using local mode.
provider "quadlet" {
  alias     = "local"
  transport = "local"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) SSH hostname or IP address. Required with ssh transport. SSH configuration files are not evaluated.
- `host_key` (String) Pinned public host key in authorized_keys format; takes precedence over known_hosts_file.
- `known_hosts_file` (String) Defaults to ~/.ssh/known_hosts. Unknown or changed keys are rejected.
- `podman_socket` (String) Absolute Podman API socket path on the target. Defaults to /run/user/<uid>/podman/podman.sock. Used only for Podman secrets.
- `port` (Number) SSH port. Defaults to 22.
- `private_key_file` (String) Private key path (supports ~/). Omit to use ssh-agent; encrypted keys must be loaded into the agent.
- `systemd_bus` (String) Absolute systemd user bus socket path on the target. Defaults to /run/user/<uid>/bus. Authentication uses the target user's UID.
- `timeout` (String) Per-operation timeout as a Go duration, including connection retries. Defaults to 15m.
- `transport` (String) Host access: ssh (default) or local. Local requires Linux and runs as the provider process user; SSH arguments must be omitted.
- `user` (String) SSH user running rootless Podman. Required with ssh transport; omit with local transport.
